changes.title: Azure cognitiveservices: Remove Cognitive Services JavaScript contract tests (#48108)
AWS Compute Optimizer now supports additional Amazon EC2 instance types in the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
changes.detail: AWS Compute Optimizer now provides rightsizing recommendations for 389 additional Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instance types in AWS GovCloud (US-West) and 276 in AWS GovCloud (US-East) Regions. Customers running regulated and government workloads can find the same cost and performance opportunities on current-generation instance types without manual analysis. Compute Optimizer has expanded support to include the latest generation families in every workload category. The additions include Compute Optimized (C7i, C7i-flex, C8g, C8gn), General Purpose (M7i, M7i-flex, M8g, M8gd, M8i,
